privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This policy explains how VV Work may collect, use and protect information when you use the platform.

collection.title: 1. Information we collect
collection.text: We may receive information that you voluntarily provide through forms on the website, including your name, contact details and message content.

usage.title: 2. How we use information
usage.text: Information you provide may be used to process requests, communicate with users, improve the platform and provide its functionality.

storage.title: 3. Data storage and protection
storage.text: We aim to use appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect information against unauthorized access, loss or misuse.

sharing.title: 4. Information sharing
sharing.text: We do not sell users’ personal data. Information may be shared with service providers when necessary to operate the platform or when required by law.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.text: Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to request access to your personal data, correction, deletion or restriction of its processing.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about privacy or the processing of personal data, please contact us through the contact page.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: This policy explains how VV Work uses cookies and similar technologies when operating the platform.

what.title: 1. What are cookies
what.text: Cookies are small text files that a website may store in your browser to support certain functionality and remember preferences.

types.title: 2. Cookies we may use
types.text: The platform may use essential cookies required for basic website functionality as well as cookies used to remember preferences selected by the user.

purpose.title: 3. Why we use cookies
purpose.text: Cookies may be used to remember preferences, support stable interface functionality and improve the user experience.

control.title: 4. Managing cookies
control.text: You can accept or reject optional cookies through the available platform settings. Cookies can also be controlled through your browser settings.

changes.title: 5. Changes to this policy
changes.text: We may update this policy periodically. The current version will always be available on this page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: These terms set out the basic rules for using the VV Work platform.

general.title: 1. General provisions
general.text: By using VV Work, you agree to use the platform in accordance with these terms and applicable law.

service.title: 2. Using the platform
service.text: VV Work provides an interface for finding vacancies, employers and other employment-related information.

responsibility.title: 3. User responsibility
responsibility.text: Users are responsible for the accuracy of information they provide through the platform and for complying with applicable law.

content.title: 4. Platform information
content.text: We aim to keep information up to date; however, vacancy conditions, employer details and other information may change.

changes.title: 5. Changes to the terms
changes.text: These terms may be updated as the platform develops. The current version is published on this page.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about these terms, you can contact the VV Work team through the contact page.
